# Māngabz fixtures

`series.html` retains metadata and all 978 rendered chapter links from [海賊王](https://www.mangabz.com/139bz/), captured on 2026-10-25. It preserves hidden entries, descending order, pinned entries, and distinct IDs that share chapter labels.

`reader.html` retains the declarations and image container for chapter `29397`, including its 20-page count. Signing values are synthetic. Browser mocks retain the captured signed-response format and first image paths, provide distinct controlled paths for subsequent batches, and return PNG image controls.
